text: We rebuilt the search page this month. Here is what changed and why. (1/4)

threadSegments: We rebuilt the search page this month. Here is what changed and why. (1/4)
Results now appear as you type. The old page waited for Enter, and plenty of people never pressed it. (2/4)
Filters stay set when you go back. Before, one tap on Back cleared everything you had picked. (3/4)
Next up: saved searches. Reply with the search you run most often and we will test with it. (4/4)
